name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A set of ready-made habits and checklists you install into an AI coding assistant so it plans, tests, and reviews its own work like a disciplined senior engineer, instead of rushing and skipping steps.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small startup who wants their AI-assisted team to produce more reliable code without hiring a dedicated process lead.
business_use_cases: A dev agency installs it across every client project so junior engineers using AI assistants ship more consistent code quality.
A solo SaaS founder uses it to stop their AI coding assistant from skipping tests and documentation under time pressure.
A coding bootcamp licenses a customized version to teach good engineering habits alongside AI-assisted coding.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid setup and tuning of the methodology for a client's specific stack and team (the README already hints at 'Commercial Services').
Sell a certified 'process-compliant' audit badge that agencies can show clients.

steal_this: Offer a one-day paid onboarding call that installs Superpowers across a client's whole repo and tunes it to their stack.
